question: A school had 40 basketballs in the equipment room at the start of the season. The gym teacher checked out 23 basketballs for the varsity team. Then 4 more were checked out for the junior varsity team. During a rainy week, 5 more balls were sent to the middle school gym, a loan that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to arrange. Finally, 7 more balls were sent to an after-school program. A donation drive then turned every remaining basketball into 7 basketballs. How many basketballs were in the equipment room after the donation drive?

A garden centre had 165 tulip bulbs in its store, and a supplier delivered 71 more. All of the bulbs were then shared equally among the 4 display beds. Squirrels dug up 7 bulbs from the first bed. The centre opened its new cafe 3 months ago. Every bulb still in the first bed will produce 2 flowers. How many flowers will the first bed produce?
Lou and Maya track money. They start with 191 dollars. They add 8 (199). They lose 95 (104). They lose 94 (10). They add 76 (86). The team manages another account. How much do they track?

Sami had 201 stamps and gave 92 of them to his friend Lia. At a stamp swap he doubled his collection, coming home with twice as many stamps as he had taken. His uncle then gave him 73 stamps and his teacher gave him 18. Sami then donated 236 stamps to the school club, so Lia now has more stamps than Sami. How many stamps does Sami have now?

A library tracked books. Starting collection: 141 volumes. She added 12 new purchases. She divided by 3 to create sections. She added 78 donations. She added 58 more. She subtracted 48 lost items. How many books total in the collection?

A car wash began the day with 108 dollars earned, multiplied across 8 identical stations, each earning that same amount, for the week's total. That total was then split evenly across 3 accounts, and only one account was tracked. A bonus week made that account grow to 5 times its size. A second bonus made it grow to 6 times its size. Since the shop records earnings in dollars but the franchise report lists cents, the manager always converted the numbers before filing. A large repair bill removed 6950 dollars. How much money was left in that account after the repair?
A warehouse had 57 items. Their partner had 150 items. They added 28. They multiplied by 8. There was a distractor of 60 items. They added 19. They removed 578. How many items?

A car wash sells its tokens in whole dollars rather than in cents. On Monday morning the kiosk held 108 tokens, and a customer returned 7 unused ones. Before lunch a taxi firm used 24 tokens. In the afternoon the owner ordered enough tokens for the kiosk to hold 6 times as many as were left. That evening the same stock was arranged for each of the 5 kiosks in the chain, and the chain repeated the whole order in all 4 towns where it operates. How many tokens does the chain now hold?

A quantity was 98 initially. By morning, it multiplied by 5. By midday, 47 were added. By afternoon, it multiplied by 8. By late afternoon, it doubled. By evening, 3102 were removed. His partner had 110 units. A distractor: another location had 85. How many final (doubling as a grouping unit)?

A vending cart's cash box held 64 cents at the start of the morning shift. By midmorning, 34 cents were paid out in change to a customer, while a coworker's separate tip jar collected 90 dimes over at the coffee stand, unrelated to this box. A bonus deposit from head office made the remaining total grow to 5 times its size. In the afternoon, 15 cents were spent on a rubber band for the register. Since the cart logs everything in cents but the daily report converts totals into dollars, the vendor always double-checked the math before closing. By evening, a customer overpaid by 40 cents and left it in the box, and overnight, a matching fund from a sponsor made that evening total grow to 4 times its size. How many cents were in the cash box the next morning?

A bakery had 89 cupcakes ready for a wedding order. Each cupcake was then paired with 4 matching mini cupcakes, multiplying the tracked total. A second order multiplied that tracked count by 5. A late addition added 32 more to the tracked count. A separate order for a birthday party, unrelated to this wedding order, needed 60 cupcakes. Finally, the cupcakes were boxed evenly into 4 boxes, and only the first box's count was tracked. How many cupcakes were in the tracked box?

In the morning, a factory produced 228 units. By afternoon, they received an order for 63 additional units. They multiplied their production by 6. They multiplied by 9 again. There was a recall of 1393 units. They doubled their output. They multiplied by 6 once more. By evening, what was their final production count?
A warehouse started with 231 boxes. In Q1, they removed 174. In Q2, they removed 41. In Q3, they added 80. In Q4, they removed 10. In year-end, they divided in half. How many boxes per facility?

Ivy had 169 shells and doubled her collection at the beach. She was given 56 shells and lost 3. Each shell is worth 5 points, and a bonus tripled her points. Ivy has more points than Jude. How many points does Ivy have?

A furniture repair shop had 41 wooden stools waiting for attention. 8 of them were beyond saving and were broken up for firewood, and a customer collected 24 that had already been mended. A house clearance then brought in 77 more stools that needed work. The joiner unscrewed all 6 legs from every stool in the shop and stacked the loose legs into bundles of 6. The shop's van holds 20 stools at a time. How many bundles of legs did the joiner stack?

In the morning Fay timed her walk to school: 34 minutes to the bridge and 7 minutes from the bridge to the gate. Since she walks there and back, her daily walking is 2 times that. In the afternoon her friend Gus worked out that he walks 2 times as far as Fay does in a day, so Gus does more walking than Fay. Gus walks that daily amount on all 7 days of the week. In the evening Gus also walked 35 minutes to a friend's house. Gus records his walking in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes did Gus walk this week?

Priya's food truck starts the day with 103 tacos prepped for the lunch rush. A large catering order takes 28 tacos right away. A dinner rush later brings in 58 more tacos that get prepped fresh. A viral social media post that evening brings her stock to 4 times what it had grown to. Her competitor, Sam, who runs a truck two blocks away, only sells about 90 tacos on a typical night. Right before closing, a batch of 4 tacos gets burned and has to be thrown out. How many tacos does Priya have ready at the end of the night?

A warehouse started with 217 boxes Monday morning. They removed 150 boxes for shipment. They removed 64 more for another order. They divided remaining by 3 for store distribution. They added 17 boxes from a return shipment. The facility operated 24 hours daily. How many boxes did each store receive?

A warehouse had 88 boxes initially. They added 51 Monday. They added 51 Tuesday. They multiplied by 2 for organization. They added 8 from recount. They added 33 more from delivery. The facility had 10 workers. How many boxes total?

A store began with 122 items. She removed 96. She added 80 back. She removed 39. She added 30 more. She added 46 additional items. She multiplied by 5. About 25 items expired, which is separate. How many items total?

A bank account started with 194 dollars. In the morning, they subtracted 23 dollars for fees. By afternoon, they added 69 dollars in deposits. By late afternoon, they added 22 dollars more. By evening, they added 42 dollars in interest (all measured in dollars throughout the day). One transfer of 18 dollars was processed separately from this account. What was the final account balance?

A student tracked 89 hours study. Morning added 36 hours. Afternoon multiplied by 7. Lost 535 to error correction. Lost 301 to revision. Gained back 36 hours. Added 35 final hours. How many hours studied?

A toy drive collected 102 action figures by the start of the week. A local business added 53 more figures on Tuesday, and a school donated 66 more figures on Wednesday. A nearby food pantry, running its own separate campaign, gathered 300 canned goods that had nothing to do with this drive. On Thursday, a matching-donor event made the toy count grow to 7 times its size. By Friday, 153 figures had to be set aside for a different charity's request. How many action figures were left for the original toy drive?

On Monday morning Ramona baked 57 trays of biscuits, and each tray held 5 rows. Every row was made up of 3 biscuits. In the afternoon her partner Ken, who baked fewer trays than Ramona, packed all the biscuits equally into 3 hampers and set the first hamper aside for the school. In the evening 42 biscuits were eaten from that hamper at a tasting. The bakery van holds 26 hampers. How many biscuits are left in the first hamper?

On Monday morning a nursery sowed 121 seeds in each of its 5 trays. By the end of the week 546 of those seeds had failed to come up. In the afternoon the gardener counted 7 stems on every plant that had grown. Each stem carries 6 flowers, and half of the greenhouse is shaded at midday. In the evening she worked out that every one of those flowers will set 7 new seeds. How many new seeds will the plants set?
